name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: No major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage found in the 48h to 18 Nov; Microsoft restored services on 14 Nov
state: Microsoft said its services were fully restored on 14 Nov after an hours-long global outage (AP via PBS). Searches found no multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage in the 48 hours to 05:40 UTC on 18 Nov, so Normal holds.
for_you: No action needed. Provider status pages give the latest during any outage.
rubric_hit: No major multi-hour outage in 48h = Normal

sources.title: PBS NewsHour (AP) — Microsoft says services fully restored after global outage

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
